scenario: An FMini sound plays its note in tune and stops when released
name: hello, ST-70: PRESETS to FMini SINE SOLO (its sine oscillator at 8', the ladder open); C4 sounds C4, and stops after its release
note: hello starts on Basic: Piano (sound 1); FMini's sounds come after the drums (engine 8), SINE SOLO is sound 46. The 45 clicks take about 350 ms on the FM-1 (each one chooses a sound), so the key waits for them. The release is the DECAY's time (fmini-1: a factory patch's releases are its decays), about a quarter of a second; then its own delay and reverb (FX: chorus 51, delay 32, reverb 32, D-093) ring on, gone by 5 s.
